name: Biochemistry PhD
detailsNote: Official annual information is available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Rotation admission and direct admission to a funded faculty group are distinct routes.

publishedDeadlines.label: Rotation application full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual fall date; recommendations due February 1. Direct faculty-group admission has no fixed deadline.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic $60. Central waivers exclusively McNair. Programs may postpone collection or cover/defer fees after review; Biochemistry-specific coverage not confirmed.

english.note: PTE 53 also accepted. Central page describes English-medium degree exemptions but later narrows degree-country wording; confirm exemption with admissions. Program says no review without TOEFL/IELTS. Separate placement/teaching-English obligations apply.

documents: Unofficial transcripts for review; official records for admission
Statement of purpose addressing program and faculty fit; upload if exceeding application’s 500-word field
requirements.note: Four-year bachelor equivalent and GPA 3.0. Preparation guidance includes chemistry through physical/analytical chemistry, calculus, physics, biology and biochemistry. Direct admission requires interested faculty with project and financial support to request review.

funding.note: Most enter with assistantships. Half-time PhD assistantship: $30,000/year, full tuition scholarship and single-student health insurance; amount undated. Rotation entrants have five-year continued support conditional on annual progress; direct-entry duration varies by offer. Students pay half mandatory fees.
